notes.title: Looking for people to model rooms.
notes.content:
We are looking for someone who works good with blender to model rooms for the game! 

If you think you would be good for this role join the discord and fill out a application to join the team!

Discord: https://discord.gg/PEAU6nW7zY

notes.title: Looking for New Team Members
notes.content:
Hello, We are looking to add some people to our our team for Development, Modeling, Art, ect. If you think you have what it takes join our discord below! We will be posting applications for people to fill out there and post news on what's going on.

Discord: https://discord.gg/QrXD7yKJ4U

notes.title: Patreon!
notes.content:
We opened a Patreon where you can get access to beta and alpha builds when available! 
It also gives access to channels in our discord where you can talk about said builds.

Buying a membership on Patreon does not give any special things in-game. Everything in the game will be opened to everyone for free.

Join the Discord here!: https://discord.gg/GwmcASkdZ9

Donate to the Patreon here!: https://www.patreon.com/WrecklessInteractive

notes.title: Discord Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We would like to announce that we have a discord for people to join to chat with us and talk about the game. You will also get to see sneak peeks of updates and such here!

Join here!: https://discord.gg/GwmcASkdZ9
